title_en: The Stance of Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers on the Hadith of Al-Atit (Part 2)
description_en: The stance of Ibn Taymiyya and his followers on the hadith of al-atit, Part 2. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: An analysis of Ibn Taymiyya's and his followers' views on the hadith concerning the creaking sound of the Throne (al-atit).
